title: Gerundio: influencia militar y poder político

sections.content: An opening gerund, or a pair of them joined by y, packs in the method behind an action — how forces were raised and dissolved, how influence was extended while alliances were negotiated. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Reuniendo estas fuerzas rápidamente cuando la situación lo exigía, y disolviéndolas de nuevo cuando el conflicto terminaba, Quiroga ejercía un poder militar flexible.
items.english: Gathering these forces quickly when the situation demanded it, and disbanding them again once the conflict ended, Quiroga wielded a flexible military power.

items.spanish: Extendiendo su influencia mediante campañas militares mientras negociaba alianzas políticas, Quiroga se convirtió en una figura muy poderosa.
items.english: Extending his influence through military campaigns while negotiating political alliances, Quiroga became a very powerful figure.

items.spanish: Cuando el poder militar y el poder político dependen de la misma persona, actuando simultáneamente como comandante y como gobernante, un colapso puede ser instantáneo.
items.english: When military and political power depend on the same person, acting simultaneously as commander and as ruler, a collapse can be instant.

items.spanish: Su muerte, dejando un vacío de poder real de la noche a la mañana, desató una crisis política considerable.
items.english: His death, leaving a real power vacuum overnight, triggered a considerable political crisis.

sections.content: Two gerunds joined by y (reuniendo... y disolviéndolas...) can describe a repeated cycle rather than a one-time action — here, forming an army and then dissolving it again, over and over, as the situation required.
